name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: 11 coins, 15 coins, and 17 coins go with Aldric, Cedric, and Godfrey, in some order.
Either Godfrey goes with 15 coins or Cooper goes with 17 coins.
Weaver goes with Cedric if and only if both Carpenter goes with Beatrix and Godfrey belongs to the Ironmongers' Guild.
Between Aldric and Beatrix, one goes with Tanner and the other with 15 coins.
Either Tanner goes with 15 coins or someone in the Clothiers' Guild goes with Aldric (but not both).

hints.text: Suppose Aldric went with 13 coins — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.

…but now the clue “11 coins, 15 coins, and 17 coins go with Aldric, Cedric, and Godfrey, in some order” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Aldric does not go with 13 coins.
